history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue to monitor the relevant reserve levels, ensure that the overall 10RCR fund balance is maintained at an appropriate level in accordance with the relevant policies and guidelines, and utilize the fund more efficiently and effectively.
history.administration_response: The Administration will continue its review of the reserve levels of the cost- recovery funds. Initial estimates for staff liabilities have been made and funds have been set aside for the liabilities. In addition, the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget has requested service providers to work on medium-term plans to provide more detail on the amounts that must be held for operating and capital costs.
history.board_assessment: Given that the review of the reserve levels remains in progress, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
